name: Can accessibility and disability modifications be incorporated into a whole home remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility and disability modifications be incorporated into a whole home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-scope remodels offer the ideal opportunity to incorporate universal design elements that enhance safety and ease of use for all ages and mobility levels. Upgrades include widening interior doorways during framing, creating curbless, zero-threshold tile showers, and adding structural backing behind bathroom drywall for sturdy grab bars. Homeowners can also plan for lever-style door hardware, custom non-slip tile surfaces, and comfort-height vanities. Addressing these accessibility features during rough framing and tile work is substantially less expensive than tearing into finished walls to retrofit them later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, widening doorways, installing curbless showers, and adding wall blocking for grab bars are easily integrated during framing and rough-in phases.
